1.web: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
1.asv: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, believe also in me.

2.web: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
2.asv: In my Father’s house are many mansions; if it were not so, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.

3.web: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
3.asv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I come again, and will receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

4.web: Where I go, you know, and you know the way.”
4.asv: And whither I go, ye know the way.

5.web: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
5.asv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; how know we the way?

6.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
6.asv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the Father, but by me.

7.web: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.”
7.asv: If ye had known me, ye would have known my Father also: from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

8.web: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
8.asv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

9.web: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’
9.asv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and dost thou not know me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; how sayest thou, Show us the Father?

10.web: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
10.asv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I say unto you I speak not from myself: but the Father abiding in me doeth his works.

11.web: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
11.asv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

12.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
12.asv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto the Father.

13.web: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
13.asv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

14.web: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
14.asv: If ye shall ask anything in my name, that will I do.

15.web: If you love me, keep my commandments.
15.asv: If ye love me, ye will keep my commandments.

16.web: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,—
16.asv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may be with you for ever,

17.web: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive; for it doesn’t see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.
17.asv: even the Spirit of truth: whom the world cannot receive; for it beholdeth him not, neither knoweth him: ye know him; for he abideth with you, and shall be in you.

18.web: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
18.asv: I will not leave you desolate: I come unto you.

19.web: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
19.asv: Yet a little while, and the world beholdeth me no more; but ye behold me: because I live, ye shall live also.

20.web: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
20.asv: In that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

21.web: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
21.asv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself unto him.

22.web: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
22.asv: Judas (not Iscariot) saith unto him, Lord, what is come to pass that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

23.web: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.
23.asv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my word: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

24.web: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
24.asv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my words: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

25.web: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.
25.asv: These things have I spoken unto you, while yet abiding with you.

26.web: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
26.asv: But the Comforter, even the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said unto you.

27.web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
27.asv: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

28.web: You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
28.asv: Ye heard how I said to you, I go away, and I come unto you. If ye loved me, ye would have rejoiced, because I go unto the Father: for the Father is greater than I.

29.web: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.
29.asv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe.

30.web: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
30.asv: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world cometh: and he hath nothing in me;

31.web: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.
31.asv: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
